title: Yo que tú…
goal: a dar y pedir consejos con If I were you y a decir lo que te encantaría hacer

vocab.es: Yo que tú… / Yo en tu lugar…

ex.t: If I were you, I'd talk to him.
ex.es: Yo que tú, hablaría con él.

ex.t: Can I give you a piece of advice?

vocab.note: Advice es incontable: some advice, nunca «an advice» ni «advices».

ex.t: My neighbour is very noisy. What would you do?
ex.es: Mi vecino hace mucho ruido. ¿Qué harías tú?

ex.t: I'd love to see the northern lights.
ex.es: Me encantaría ver la aurora boreal.

ex.t: I'd rather stay at home tonight.
ex.es: Preferiría quedarme en casa esta noche.

ex.t: It would be nice to have a garden.
Would I go skydiving? Not in a million years!
You can stay with us. — That would be great!
ex.es: Puedes quedarte con nosotros. — ¡Eso sería estupendo!

pron.title: La entonación del consejo
pron.tip: En «If I were you, I'd…» la voz sube un poco en you, hace una pausa y baja al final. Suena amable, no mandón.

exercises.q: If I ___ you, I'd call the doctor today.
exercises.why: Para aconsejar: If I were you.
Advice es incontable: some advice o a piece of advice.

exercises.q: I'd rather ___ at home tonight. I'm tired.
I'd love ___ New Zealand one day.
If I were you, I ___ worry so much. Everything will be fine.
It would be nice ___ a long holiday this summer.
exercises.why: It would be nice + to + verbo.

exercises.context: Tu hijo Hugo está agotado y no duerme bien. Le aconsejas que se tome unos días libres.
options: If I were you, I'd take a few days off.
If I am you, I take a few days off.
If I were you, I will take a few days off.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I'd take a few days off.
exercises.why: If I were you + I'd + verbo.

exercises.context: Una amiga te propone tirarte en paracaídas. ¡Ni hablar!
exercises.why: Not in a million years = ¡ni loca!, ¡ni en sueños!

exercises.context: Tu amiga tiene un problema con su vecino y quieres saber qué haría ella en tu caso.
exercises.why: Para pedir consejo: What would you do?

exercises.q: Can I give you an advice about your trip?
exercises.why: Advice es incontable: some advice o a piece of advice.

exercises.q: If I were you, I will book the hotel now.
exercises.why: Después de If I were you, el consejo va con would ('d).

exercises.es: Yo que tú, no le diría nada
exercises.answer: If I were you I wouldn't say anything
exercises.why: If I were you + I wouldn't + verbo.

answer: I'd love to learn to swim.
I would love to learn to swim.
I'd love to learn how to swim.
I would love to learn how to swim.

exercises.instr: Da el mismo consejo con If I were you
exercises.q: You should buy a warmer coat.
answer: If I were you, I'd buy a warmer coat.
If I were you, I would buy a warmer coat.
exercises.why: You should… = If I were you, I'd…

exercises.t: If I were you, I'd take a few days off.
exercises.es: Yo que tú, me tomaría unos días libres.

dialog.title: Un consejo para Hugo
dialog.setting: Hugo llama a su madre porque le han ofrecido un trabajo en Nueva Zelanda

lines.t: Mum, I've had a job offer in Auckland!
lines.es: ¡Mamá, me han ofrecido un trabajo en Auckland!

lines.t: Auckland? That's so far away! What would you do there?
I'd work for a big company. What would you do if you were me?
lines.es: Trabajaría para una gran empresa. ¿Qué harías tú en mi lugar?

lines.t: Honestly? If I were you, I'd take it.
Really? I thought you'd say no!
lines.es: ¿En serio? ¡Pensaba que me dirías que no!

lines.t: I'd miss you, of course. But it's a great opportunity.
lines.es: Te echaría de menos, claro. Pero es una gran oportunidad.

lines.t: You could visit me! Would you like that?
I'd love to! That would be a dream come true.
lines.es: ¡Me encantaría! Sería un sueño hecho realidad.

questions.q: ¿Dónde le han ofrecido trabajo a Hugo?

options: Que se lo piense un año

questions.q: ¿Qué le haría mucha ilusión a Yolanda?

realLife.t: If I were you, I'd take it.
realLife.context: Para animar a alguien a aceptar una oportunidad

summary: Consejos: If I were you, I'd… / I wouldn't…
Pedir consejo: What would you do (if you were me)?
I'd love to… = me encantaría · I'd rather… = preferiría
Advice es incontable: some advice, a piece of advice
